baseline_models.mechanism: Collective haste is yoked to a root image of lagging behind good and then given a boundary-crossing vector: the motion is fast, but its moral result is accelerated backwardness.

activation_trace.role: Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the overt velocity of the plural action.
Delay from good supplies the paradoxical destination: their haste makes them fall behind good faster.
Crossing a limit in injustice turns raw speed into directed transgression.

changed_reading.before: They quickly commit sin and aggression.
changed_reading.after: Their coordinated haste is itself a mechanism that rapidly carries them into moral lateness and across protective limits.

baseline_models.mechanism: The eating construction can denote taking and consuming wealth, while suht can denote stripping away and eradication. The intake therefore consumes not only an illicit object but the protected basis from which value is drawn.

activation_trace.role: Consumption and taking of wealth supplies the acquisitive intake.
Stripping, removal, and eradication make that intake corrosive to its own source.
Dealings between people locate the corrosive intake within repeatable social transactions.

changed_reading.after: Their illicit intake is extractive: a social transaction that strips away the very protections and sources on which continued exchange depends.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ ... مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Perception frames a numerous cohort whose intentional work is present across time. The ayah diagnoses an observable, repeated practice rather than an invisible essence or a single lapse.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight makes conduct, rather than hidden identity, the evidentiary surface.
Growth of number marks a large but bounded cohort within the larger group.
Occurrence across time gives the closing evaluation durative force.
Purposive action makes the pattern practiced work rather than accidental motion.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns a group for bad behavior.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks the observer to recognize a numerous, behavior-defined cohort through its repeated and purposive public practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding entry-exit sequence carries the same covered condition through both boundaries and ends in concealment. The visible rush in the focus ayah can therefore be the outward traffic of an orientation that remains continuous underneath.

activation_trace.role: Visible perception anchors the model in what the focus ayah exposes.
Passage into an interior supplies the first boundary of the concealed continuity.
Covering supplies the condition carried through the movement.
Passage outward supplies the second boundary while the condition remains unchanged.
Concealment explains why stable inward continuity becomes legible only through later conduct.

structural_cues: 5:61 immediately precedes the focus and brackets motion with دَخَلُوا۟ ... خَرَجُوا۟ بِهِ before naming concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same covered condition at entry and exit plus concealment; I infer that this persistence underlies the next ayah's visible speed. A live alternative is that 5:61 describes hypocrisy without causally explaining the haste.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah reports spontaneous visible haste.
changed_reading.after: The visible rush can be the behavioral exposure of a concealed orientation carried intact through changing social boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sequence is repeated beside an unanswered demand for learned authorities to restrain it, then later generalized as failure to restrain one another. The shift from working to making lets the bad action read as a maintained social product whose brakes are absent.

activation_trace.role: Speed supplies the process that requires an interrupting brake.
Purposive work is revised from isolated acts into a maintained practice.
Restraint and stopping supply the missing institutional brake immediately after the focus.
Making a thing recasts the repeated conduct as something socially produced.
Mutual failure to stop wrongdoing extends the missing brake from officeholders to peers.
Repeatedly bringing an act about confirms that non-restraint sustains enacted practice.

structural_cues: 5:63 repeats الإِثْم, أَكْل, السُّحْت, بِئْسَ, and كَانُوا۟ from the focus while changing يَعْمَلُونَ to يَصْنَعُونَ.
5:79 repeats the non-restraint and بِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated stopping failures and a work-to-making shift; I infer a production loop whose absent institutional and peer brakes enable acceleration. The alternative is emphatic synonymy without a distinct production mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They repeatedly perform bad acts quickly.
changed_reading.after: Their haste is a socially manufactured practice kept in motion by the failure of both authorities and peers to interrupt it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Open hands and outgoing expenditure are followed by a conditional image of eating provision from above and below within an upright, moderate community. Against those channels, eating suht becomes counter-circulation: acquisitive intake that strips sources instead of receiving and redistributing provision.

activation_trace.role: Taking and consuming wealth anchors the focus as inward acquisition.
Stripping and eradication make the inward acquisition destructive to its channels.
The extended, released hand supplies an opposed posture of open capacity.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies circulation rather than hoarded intake.
A consumed share or provision supplies the sustaining counterpart to illicit consumption.
Provision from an upper direction opens one side of the surrounding supply field.
Provision from beneath completes the image of supply arriving through the environment.
Moderation between extremes supplies the social balance compatible with sustaining provision.

structural_cues: The packet sets أَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ against لَأَكَلُوا۟ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ.
5:64 places bound-hand speech beside open hands and expenditure before the later provisioning contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed intake, open expenditure, and environmental provision; I infer two circulation regimes, one sustaining and one extractive. A live alternative is that the eating passages are only moral contrasts without an economic or ecological flow model.

changed_reading.before: Eating suht means receiving forbidden income.
changed_reading.after: Eating suht is a counter-economy that converts open provision and circulation into acquisitive stripping, eroding both source and social balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: An incoming disclosure that could correct conduct instead increases excess in many. Linked back to many racing across limits, the motion becomes positive feedback: corrective input is converted into gain for the transgressive process.

activation_trace.role: Speed supplies the observable output of the amplifying process.
Boundary crossing identifies the output as excess rather than neutral growth.
Increase and growth supply the feedback gain.
A numerous cohort ties the gain to the focus ayah's many.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience names what the increase amplifies.
The repeated increase confirms that the response to incoming disclosure is not a one-time spike.
The repeated many stabilizes the same cohort-level amplification.
Repeated limit-excess fixes the direction of the increased response.

structural_cues: 5:64 and 5:68 repeat وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم ... طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated increase of excess among many after incoming disclosure; I infer a feedback arrow from resisted correction to faster transgression. The alternative is cohort description without a causal connection to the focus ayah's speed.

changed_reading.before: Many are simply eager to sin.
changed_reading.after: Their haste can be a self-amplifying response system in which even corrective input is converted into further collective excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated blindness and deafness remove corrective sensory feedback, while the closing divine seeing of what they do makes observability asymmetric. The focus's ترى then does more than report: it exposes a loop visible from outside but unregistered by its participants.

activation_trace.role: Seeing anchors the outside observation that detects the racing pattern.
Purposive work is the repeated output made visible to the observer.
Repeated blindness of insight removes visual correction inside the acting cohort.
Repeated loss of hearing and non-attention removes auditory correction.
Seeing of their work supplies the opposed, uninterrupted observation.

structural_cues: 5:71 repeats فَعَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ on both sides of ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ and closes with وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent sensory closure and an observer who still sees the work; I infer that failed feedback permits the rapid behavior to recur. A live alternative is a moral contrast between blindness and divine sight without a process claim.

changed_reading.before: You can see them rushing into wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The rush is an externally visible loop whose participants repeatedly disable the very sight and hearing that could correct it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact ترى كثيرا منهم frame returns for harmful attachment, while later finding and seeing disclose a contrasting cohort whose nearness, affection, overflowing eyes, and recognition are likewise behavioral. The focus's many is therefore an observed response-class, not an undifferentiated identity.

activation_trace.role: Seeing anchors classification in observable response.
Numerousness marks a substantial subset without exhausting the containing group.
The repeated seeing frame confirms a second observable conduct-based diagnosis.
The repeated many preserves bounded cohort language in the later diagnosis.
Advancing something ahead turns present attachment into a consequence-producing trajectory.
Finding or encountering supplies comparative observation across opposed response cohorts.
Nearness supplies the relational direction of the contrasting cohort.
Affection gives that nearness a positive social quality.
Easy abundant overflow makes reception visibly embodied rather than merely claimed.
Recognition through a sign supplies the perceptive trigger for the contrasting response.

structural_cues: 5:80 exactly reopens with تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ and again closes with a بِئْسَ evaluation.
5:82-83 move from comparative finding to visibly overflowing eyes after recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated observational formulas and sharply different visible responses; I infer that the focus ayah's many is indexed by conduct rather than total identity. The alternative is simple juxtaposition of groups without a deliberate rescoping of مِنْهُمْ.

changed_reading.before: Many members of the named group share one fixed character.
changed_reading.after: A large but bounded cohort is identified by its visible response pattern, while the same context preserves other cohorts whose observable responses run in a different direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the disease-transfer branch of ع د و rather than the ordinary boundary-violation sense of العُدْوَان. It remains anchored in that exact focus root, plural speed, numerical spread, and later social attachment; downstream prose should present it only as an analogy for propagation, not as a replacement lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: Transfer of disease supplies an exploratory image of transgression propagating between people.
Speed supplies the propagation rate.
Increase in number supplies the population-level spread.
Alliance and affiliative attachment supply the contact network through which a practice could propagate.

changed_reading.before: Aggression is a set of individual violations.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, transgression behaves like a socially transmitted practice that moves rapidly through attachments and expands across a cohort.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins the fire-feeding branch of eating to the stripping branch of suht and the nearby war-fire sequence. The exact focus roots and packet sequence keep it anchored, but downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not claim that السحت literally denotes fuel or fire.

activation_trace.role: Feeding fire and ignition recast illicit intake as provision for combustion.
Eradication makes the fed process consume and remove its own substrate.
Combustible material supplies the contextual image of a conflict process requiring fuel.
Cooling flame and embers supplies the repeated termination of the fueled process.

changed_reading.before: They consume unlawful wealth for gain.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they feed a combustion whose fuel strips away its own substrate and whose flare is repeatedly put out.

strongest_changes: Speed became a paradoxical engine of delay from good and boundary crossing, not merely intensity.
Eating suht became extractive counter-circulation opposed to open expenditure and sustaining provision.
Repeated non-restraint and sensory closure turned the conduct into a socially maintained feedback loop.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly returned to the focus's observation, many, eating, bad-work, and transgression language while supplying opposed flow systems and opposed visible response cohorts; this made a process reading stronger than a static catalogue of vices.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from concealment, non-restraint, and sensory closure to acceleration are reader-supplied, even though their sequence is packet-grounded.
The circulation model may be stronger as a moral-economic analogy than as a single lexical synthesis.
The contagion and combustion outliers depend on form-distant branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.
